findings.documented: API key passed as query parameter ?api_key=IVY26-XXXXXXXXXXXX
findings.actual: API key query parameter is rejected (401); X-API-Key HTTP header must be supplied on every request
findings.how_found: Called GET /v1/listings?api_key=... and received HTTP 401 with detail 'send your key in the X-API-Key request header'
findings.impact: All API calls fail with 401 if query parameter is used as documented

findings.documented: Returns token key in response body, valid for 86400 seconds (24 hours) with no refresh flow
findings.actual: Returns access_token key, expires_in is 900 seconds (15 minutes), and includes refresh_token with refresh_url /auth/refresh
findings.how_found: Inspected JSON response payload of POST /auth/login
findings.impact: Applications expecting 'token' property break, and sessions expire after 15 minutes unless refresh flow is implemented

findings.documented: No token refresh flow exists in API documentation
findings.actual: POST /auth/refresh endpoint exists and accepts refresh_token to issue a new access_token
findings.how_found: Observed refresh_url in POST /auth/login response and tested POST /auth/refresh
findings.impact: Enables seamless session maintenance without requiring re-entering user password

findings.documented: Invalidates the current token server side
findings.actual: Tokens are stateless JWTs; endpoint returns note that tokens must be discarded client side
findings.how_found: Called POST /auth/logout and received {'ok': True, 'note': 'tokens are stateless; discard them client side'}
findings.impact: Server does not track token blacklists; client application must purge token locally

findings.documented: Pagination uses page and limit parameters, with page being 1-indexed. Response contains page and page_size.
findings.actual: The page parameter is ignored. Pagination uses offset and limit parameters. Response contains offset, limit, count, total, and has_more.
findings.how_found: Passed page=2 with limit=10 and received identical results as page=1 (offset 0); passing offset=10 returned page 2 results.
findings.impact: Client applications using page parameter get stuck on the first page endlessly

findings.actual: Limit parameter is capped at 50 server-side
findings.how_found: Requested limit=200 and observed response limit and count returned 50 items
findings.impact: Fetching complete dataset requires 4x more requests than documented

findings.documented: Returns active sale listings; inactive, expired and withdrawn listings are excluded server side
findings.actual: Returns inactive listings where is_live is false
findings.how_found: Filtered fetched listings by is_live field and found 44 inactive listings (is_live=False)
findings.impact: Frontend must explicitly filter by is_live=true to avoid displaying unavailable listings

findings.documented: total field in response indicates exact number of records matching filters and can be used to determine pagination end
findings.actual: total field in response body reports 3318 listings, but 3500 total listings exist and can be retrieved by paging past 3318
findings.how_found: Paged past offset 3318 while has_more was true until offset 3500 where has_more became false
findings.impact: Applications relying on total count stop fetching early and miss 182 listing records

findings.documented: Endpoint path for single listing is GET /v1/listing/{listing_id}
findings.actual: GET /v1/listing/{id} returns HTTP 404 Not Found. The correct endpoint is plural GET /v1/listings/{id}
findings.impact: Listing detail page requests fail if written as documented

findings.documented: Returns up to ten comparable listings via GET /v1/listings/{id}/similar
findings.impact: Similar listings UI feature must be computed client side or using search filters

findings.documented: Favourites CRUD endpoints exist at GET /v1/favourites, POST /v1/favourites, DELETE /v1/favourites/{id}
findings.actual: All /v1/favourites endpoints return HTTP 404 Not Found
findings.how_found: Tested GET, POST, and DELETE calls to /v1/favourites and received 404 Not Found
findings.impact: Saved listings functionality must be implemented in client local storage

findings.documented: GET /v1/analytics/summary returns pre-computed aggregates for dashboard
findings.how_found: Called GET /v1/analytics/summary and received HTTP 404 Not Found
findings.impact: Analytics summary must be aggregated client side from raw listing/rental/project data

findings.documented: price_min and price_max are in integer rupees
findings.actual: price_min and price_max are given as floating-point numbers in Crores or Lakhs (e.g. 1.66 Cr or 94.6 Lakhs)
findings.how_found: Inspected price_min and price_max in /v1/projects response objects (e.g. min=1.66, max=4.54)
findings.impact: Displaying project prices directly without unit conversion shows inaccurate numbers

findings.documented: total_listings in project object is recomputed whenever a listing is added or withdrawn, so it always agrees with listings in that project
findings.actual: total_listings reported in project objects disagrees with actual listing counts for 295 out of 400 projects
findings.how_found: Cross-referenced total_listings in /v1/projects against actual count of listings with matching project_id in /v1/listings
findings.impact: Project cards display inaccurate listing counts to users

findings.documented: Every listing record describes valid physical property data
findings.actual: 18 listing records describe impossible physical data (negative prices, floor > total_floors, or carpet_area > super_built_up_area)
findings.how_found: Executed data validation checks across floor/total_floors, prices, and carpet vs super built up area
findings.impact: Showing corrupt listings degrades user trust and breaks analytics calculations if not filtered out

findings.documented: All listings are genuine property sales
findings.actual: 6 fake clickbait listings exist with prices in thousands (e.g. Rs 5,030 for 1BHK in Mg Road) to capture lead enquiries
findings.how_found: Analyzed price-to-carpet-area ratios and identified listings with prices under Rs 30,000
findings.impact: Fake listings distort market pricing averages and mislead users

findings.documented: Returns service status and the server clock
findings.actual: server_time carries an explicit +05:30 offset and response includes reference_date field
findings.impact: none - explicit timezone offset enables unambiguous datetime parsing
